details.policy: CSV workflow handoff (2026-10-08): library-cleaned.csv replaces combined.csv as the canonical working sheet. The reviewed XLSX remains a historical snapshot, and routine CSV commands do not rewrite it. Preserve all 31 cleaned columns and literal citation keys. flag uses TRUE/FALSE in CSV and is never exported to BibTeX. Imports require explicit filenames, existing record replacement requires --update and replaces the whole record, deleted key assignments remain reserved in citation-key-registry.json, and every export must pass complete BibTeX value round-trip validation. Workflow events are recorded in workflow-audit.jsonl. This supersedes the earlier XLSX source-of-truth statement for ongoing maintenance.
